description: 国王印度防御——黑象远程狙击d4，超现代控制中心经典，16步完整注释

intro.popup_en: A fianchettoed bishop can target d4 from across the board. The King's Indian lets White occupy the center first, then uses the bishop's long diagonal to undermine it.
intro.popup: 黑象斜跨棋盘远程狙击 d4——最经典超现代控制！国王印度展示如何让对手先占中心，再用一个象的斜线撕裂对方阵型

outro.popup_en: One well-placed bishop can exert more pressure than several pawn advances. From g7, the bishop's long diagonal reaches across the center; this is the essence of long-range piece control.
outro.popup: 一个好象的斜线，胜过许多兵的推进。Bg7 从 g7 到 a1 的对角线覆盖了整个棋盘中心区域，这就是子力远程控制的精髓。

moves.popup_en: 1.d4 occupies the center. White aims to build a broad d4-e4 pawn center, while Black initially allows the space.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 1.d4 — 白方占领中心！
白方建立 d4，计划形成 d4+e4 双兵庞大中心。黑方将「暂时」让步……

moves.popup_en: 1...Nf6 controls e4 and makes White's central advance harder, without occupying the center with a pawn.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 1...Nf6 — 黑马控制 e4！
黑马在 f6 控制 e4，不让白方轻松推 e4。但黑方不急于占领中心兵……

moves.popup_en: 2.c4 expands White's central control alongside d4. White's plan to build a broad d4-e4 center is clear.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 2.c4 — 白方扩大控制！
c4 配合 d4，双兵形成强大中心控制。白方的意图越来越明显：建立 d4+e4 庞大兵中心。

moves.popup_en: 2...g6 prepares ...Bg7 rather than directly contesting the center. The King's Indian idea is to let White advance, then counter from the bishop's long diagonal.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 2...g6 — 黑方准备象纤维化！
g6 不是直接争夺中心，而是为 Bg7 铺路。这就是国王印度的奥秘——先让白方，再用象远程反制！

moves.popup_en: 3.Nc3 supports e4 and controls d5, preparing White's central expansion.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 3.Nc3 — 白马支撑 e4！
白马在 c3，控制 d5 和 e4，为 e4 推进做最后准备。

moves.popup_en: 3...Bg7! Black fianchettoes the bishop on the long diagonal toward a1. The d4-square lies on this line, so the bishop targets White's central pawn from a distance. Black patiently waits for the right moment to counterattack.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 3...Bg7 — 关键一步！象纤维化，狙击 d4！
黑象占据 g7，沿 h8-a1 对角线向整个棋盘延伸！d4 格就在这条斜线上，Bg7 从远处直接「锁定」d4！
★ 这是国王印度的核心：象在 g7，静静地瞄准 d4，等待反击时机！

moves.popup_en: 4.e4! White builds the broad d4-e4 center. It looks dominant, but Black's bishop on g7 is already aimed at the central structure.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 4.e4 — 白方建立庞大中心！
白方终于推出 e4，建立 d4+e4 的庞大双兵中心。看起来白方占据了绝对优势……但 Bg7 已经就位！

moves.popup_en: 4...d6 controls e5 and prevents White from establishing a pawn there. Black consolidates before opening the center.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 4...d6 — 黑方扼守 e5，暂时防守。
d6 兵扼守 e5，防止白方在 e5 建立据点。黑方暂时没有推 e5，而是积蓄力量。

moves.popup_en: 5.Nf3 controls e5 and d4. White has completed a solid central setup.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 5.Nf3 — 白马加强中心。
白马在 f3，控制 e5 和 d4。白方阵型完整，中心看似无法撼动。

moves.popup_en: 5...O-O secures Black's king while preserving the bishop's long diagonal for future activity.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 5...O-O — 黑方易位，王的安全！
黑方易位，将王放在安全位置。此时 Bg7 的斜线力量仍然完整，随时准备激活。

moves.popup_en: 6.Be2 develops White's bishop and prepares castling.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 6.Be2 — 白方出象，准备易位。
白象发展，白方阵型趋于完整。

moves.popup_en: 6...e5! Black strikes when ready, directly challenging d4 and opening the center. The ...e5 break combines with the pressure from Bg7 to put White's center under strain.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 6...e5 — 黑方反击！中心炸开！
时机成熟！黑方推 e5，直接挑战 d4，打开中心。Bg7 的斜线压力与 e5 的反击配合，让白方中心陷入危机！

moves.popup_en: 7.O-O completes White's castling. Both sides enter the characteristic King's Indian middlegame battle.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 7.O-O — 白方易位完成。
双方易位完成，进入国王印度最精彩的中局争斗！

moves.popup_en: 7...Nc6! Black adds pressure to d4 and e5. Together, Bg7, Nc6, and the ...e5 break create a strong counterattacking setup.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 7...Nc6 — 黑马加压！
黑马出动，进一步施压 d4 和 e5 区域。Bg7 + Nc6 + e5 形成强大的反击态势！

moves.popup_en: 8.d5! White closes the center to avoid further exchanges, but Black's bishop still exerts pressure along the long diagonal.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 8.d5 — 白方关闭中心！
白方推 d5，关闭中心，避免更大的中心兑换。但 Bg7 的斜线仍然有效……

moves.popup_en: 8...Ne7 reroutes the knight, with options to develop toward c8 or f5 and support a kingside ...f5-f4 push. The bishop on g7 began watching d4 on move three and waited for the right moment to strike: long-range control takes patience.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 8...Ne7 — 黑马重新部署！
黑马退到 e7，准备从 c8 或 f5 跳出，或者支持 f5-f4 的王翼进攻。
★ 总结：Bg7 从第3步就开始「监视」d4，等待了5步才爆发——子力的远程控制需要耐心！
